Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Discover the opportunity to make impactful decisions and collaborate across multiple groups to drive success. You will manage and engage with various teams, contributing to key decisions and providing effective solutions to challenges that arise. This role will embrace expertise in Playwright Test Automation to foster innovation and continuous improvement. Join us in shaping a dynamic environment where your insights and collaboration will be highly valued and celebrated.
Leverage predictive and intelligent testing approaches using Playwright automation to enhance quality, efficiency, and test coverage.
Participate in the creation, enhancement, and maintenance of Playwright-based automation frameworks to support evolving project needs.
Translate business and system requirements into scalable automated test scenarios and reusable test assets.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of automation strategies and quality objectives across the delivery lifecycle.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve testing processes, framework capabilities, and CI/CD integration through modern automation practices.
 HERE'S WHAT YOU WILL NEED:
Expert proficiency in Playwright Test Automation Framework.
A minimum of 4 years of experience in automated testing using modern frameworks and tools.
Strong experience with TypeScript or JavaScript for test automation development.
Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field of studies.
 BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:
Expert proficiency in Playwright framework design, maintenance, and optimization.
Expert proficiency in Technical Test Execution.
Advanced proficiency in Test Planning and Automation Strategy.
Intermediate proficiency in Quality Assurance.
Beginner proficiency in Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD).
 Join us for a fulfilling career and a balanced lifestyle that celebrates diversity and promotes inclusivity.
